cases.prompt: Use the work-status agent to report which steps of the plan's current section passed, which are blocked and which are still open. Write its answer to status.md.
Use the work-status agent to list what is still pending before the plan's current section is done. Write the list to left.md.
Use the work-status agent to find out whether the work on the plugin is implemented, verified, merged and released. Write its answer to status.md.
In the plugin's own code under plugin/, which file adds the "unverified quote" label to map entries? Write its path to answer.md.
